name: qfx-wow-addon-ui-plugin
description: Reusable Codex skill for designing and refactoring World of Warcraft addon UIs with Blizzard-native controls, compact multilingual layout, modular architecture, safe media handling, SavedVariables migration, event/OnUpdate discipline, traceable minimal-diff reports, Plater-inspired table-driven options patterns, load-on-demand tabs, searchable settings, reusable scroll rows, packaging checks, performance, and taint-safety checks.

interface.longDescription: Guides Codex to design, review, and refactor World of Warcraft addon interfaces using native Blizzard-style controls, compact multilingual layout, duplicate-control avoidance, modular UI factory rules, safe font/media fallback, SavedVariables migration, event/OnUpdate discipline, traceability, Plater-inspired table-driven option pages, load-on-demand complex tabs, searchable settings, reusable scroll rows, large-list performance rules, release packaging checks, and Retail 12.x secret-value/taint safety.
defaultPrompt: Use QFX WoW Addon UI to refactor this add-on settings panel into a Blizzard-native unified layout using the existing UI factory.

Use QFX WoW Addon UI to apply Plater-style options design: tabbed categories, table-driven option rows, reusable templates, delayed creation of heavy pages, searchable settings, and one global refresh callback.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to compact this settings page, account for English/zhCN/zhTW label length, and fully use the available template width without overflow.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to remove duplicate controls with the same effective function unless their scopes are clearly different.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to replace labeled color buttons with compact textless swatches that open the color picker and update immediately.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to review this WoW add-on UI for layout drift, custom controls, localization gaps, taint risk, performance problems, and packaging completeness.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to fix this saved voice collection UI: selection, drag-out behavior, long sound picker, TTS test path, and large-list refresh performance.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to prepare release notes and a package checklist for this QFX add-on.
